b: The new release centres around the group's November 2024 concerts at the Sydney Opera House
The The are releasing a live album, The Ensouled Tour – Live At The Sydney Opera House.

The full-length concert recording includes 27 songs arranged in 2 sets, and was captured during the group's November 2024 concerts at the Sydney Opera House. It will be made available in a triple-vinyl edition, as well as in a crystal-clear triple-vinyl limited edition version. There will also be a double CD mediabook, and the full-length film will be released on both DVD and Blu-ray too.
The new live album follows on from the 2021 release of The Comeback Special – Live At The Royal Albert Hall.
